baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah separates a coercive command channel from an enduring relationship channel: pressure can be refused as direction while companionship continues as recognizable good.

activation_trace.role: Pressure carries a person toward the limit of hardship, supplying the coercive load that triggers refusal.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the evidentiary threshold that the demanded association fails.
Compliance means yielding to and proceeding with an order, the channel explicitly blocked here.
Ongoing company and attachment preserve the relationship after directive compliance is denied.
A good recognized by mind, disposition, and norm gives companionship an affirmative ethical quality.

changed_reading.before: The ayah tells a child not to obey parents who demand association while remaining kind.
changed_reading.after: The ayah decomposes filial agency: block an epistemically groundless command under pressure, yet continue protective, recognizably good companionship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ / وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّ
baseline_models.mechanism: A negated knowledge-state closes one route, while trace-following, an extended way, and recurrent return open another. Authority is rendered as inspectable wayfinding rather than inherited personal force.

activation_trace.role: The frozen negation denies the present existence of the demanded warrant.
A distinguishing mark that guides toward a thing turns knowledge into route evidence, not mere information.
Stepwise tracing of an effect supplies the method by which the alternative route is tested and followed.
An extended traversable road supplies the positive object of following.
Repeated return toward a place or toward God makes reorientation a durable pattern rather than one declaration.

changed_reading.before: Reject unsupported association and follow a pious person.
changed_reading.after: Test authority as wayfinding: refuse an unmarked claim and trace a route whose visible pattern is repeated reorientation to God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence nests iterative human return inside a universal final return and then converts intentional conduct into a delivered report. The singular guide yields to a plural audit that includes every party addressed.

activation_trace.role: Return occurring time after time supplies the guide's practiced reorientation.
Restoration to the originating direction supplies the terminal convergence of all addressees.
An arriving, consequential report turns return into disclosed accountability.
Conduct's occurrence through time supplies the span gathered by the report.
Purposive action supplies the accountable material rather than mere affiliation or claim.

changed_reading.before: An afterlife warning is appended to the family instruction.
changed_reading.after: The close resets jurisdiction: an exemplar guides provisionally, but child and parents alike converge on a report of their own intentional conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا ... ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Companionship is positively retained but spatially and temporally scoped to the near world; final return prevents relational proximity from becoming ultimate co-ownership of allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Preservation through accompaniment gives the worldly bond active care rather than bare tolerance.
Nearness supplies the domain in which parental proximity remains operative.
The nearer or first world supplies a provisional temporal layer contrasted with final return.
Shared ownership supplies the exact overreach that proximity must not become.
Return to the originating direction terminates the provisional jurisdiction of the near bond.

changed_reading.before: In this life simply means to treat the parents well while alive.
changed_reading.after: The phrase scopes a real, caring bond to the near domain while withholding from that bond any ultimate share in allegiance or judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sequence first makes parental debt concrete through pregnancy, compounded weakness, and gratitude, then places weaning and the destination to God beside the coercion case. The focus boundary therefore measures a weighty claim rather than dismissing it.

activation_trace.role: Explicitly assigning a partner to God fixes the nontransferable boundary before the parental case.
A charge connected and delivered to another supplies the genuine binding force of the parental instruction.
Parenthood constituted by birth grounds the reciprocal relation invoked on both sides of gratitude.
Bearing as hardship gives the mother's claim embodied cost rather than abstract status.
Repeated loss of strength intensifies the debt that remains honored through companionship.
A nursing child separated from the mother supplies a natural boundary within an enduring filial bond.
Recognition of benefit preserves gratitude even when one command cannot be followed.
Movement to the final outcome limits every intermediate claim.

structural_cues: 31:13-15 moves from a father's warning, through embodied parental debt, to dual-parent pressure.
The command to thank God and parents is immediately bounded by destination to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies real parental cost, gratitude, separation, destination, and prohibited association; I infer that embodied debt raises the claim without transferring allegiance. A live alternative is that weaning is only biographical timing and not a model for the limit.

changed_reading.before: Remain kind despite having to disobey.
changed_reading.after: Precisely because parental debt is weighty, the ayah calibrates it: gratitude and care persist, while a weaning-like boundary prevents that debt from becoming transferable allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same recognized-good lexeme is placed between commanding and restraining, opposite a repellent wrong, and followed by patient endurance. In the focus, good companionship can therefore be active counterconduct rather than passive coexistence.

activation_trace.role: Publicly recognizable good turns the focus manner-word into norm-governed conduct.
A repellent wrong that calls for restraint supplies the negative edge of recognized good.
Request with binding force makes the good something enacted and advocated, not merely felt.
Checking and holding back an act models ethical refusal within continuing social engagement.
Self-restraint under distress supplies the durability needed to combine refusal with companionship.

structural_cues: 31:17 coordinates command, prohibition, and patience around the recognized-good term used in 31:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated lexeme, its opposite, and an imperative sequence; I infer that 31:17 sharpens the manner of filial companionship into active ethical practice. The alternative is that 31:15 uses only ordinary courteous treatment.

changed_reading.before: Companionship means generic kindness after refusal.
changed_reading.after: Companionship is disciplined counterconduct: refuse the wrong, continue publicly recognizable good, and absorb the relational cost without reproducing coercion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere a road is obscured by distracting discourse, dispute lacks knowledge, guidance, and an illuminating record, and the same following verb takes either what descends from God or what was found on ancestors. Following itself is neutral; provenance and marks discriminate tracks.

activation_trace.role: A traversable road can be diverted from, showing that a named way remains vulnerable to competing traffic.
The missing distinguishing mark explains how discourse can pull a traveler off the road.
Absent disclosure to a knower removes one support from contentious religious speech.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies directional guidance alongside knowledge.
Ordered letters and their written record supply a stable inspectable source for the route.
A visible beacon supplies orientation that unsupported dispute lacks.
The same act of going after another serves both revealed and inherited objects, proving that followership alone does not validate a track.
Delivery from above supplies the provenance of the first competing object of following.
Paternal nurture and ancestry supply the relational provenance of the rival track.

structural_cues: 31:21 repeats the same follow verb for a revealed object and an inherited object.
31:6 and 31:20 pair route deviation or dispute with lack of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival followings and a cluster of route tests; I infer that these tests specify how to recognize the path of one who returns. An inherited route may still be right, so the live alternative is overlap rather than an absolute novelty-versus-tradition contrast.

changed_reading.before: Replace obedience to erring parents with imitation of a better person.
changed_reading.after: Select between competing tracks: valid following is marked by knowledge, directional guidance, inspectable revelation, and repeated return, while ancestry by itself supplies no route warrant.

context_deltas.mechanism: A mustard-weight enclosed in rock or the cosmos is brought forth, and the focus return-report formula recurs with knowledge of inward sources. The final informing reads as retrieval and exposure of purposive action, including what pressure or privacy concealed.

activation_trace.role: An exact small weight makes even minimally scaled conduct recoverable.
A massive hard enclosure supplies the strongest image of concealment around the small item.
Fineness, minuteness, and hiddenness bridge the concealed item to exact divine access.
Knowledge of inward reality supplies access behind the enclosure.
The repeated terminal return confirms that the focus audit is not confined to the family scene.
The repeated consequential report confirms disclosure as the result of return.
Repeated purposive action identifies the item being disclosed.
The inward source from which acts issue extends the audit behind outward compliance.
Repeated divine knowing closes the surah with the epistemic capacity that makes full reporting possible.
Human acquired knowing is twice denied over future gain and death-place, sharpening the asymmetry behind the focus knowledge test.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests the small item inside rock, heavens, or earth and then predicates its being brought.
31:23 repeats the focus return-report-action sequence nearly clause for clause.
31:34 contrasts repeated divine knowledge with repeated human non-knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed weight, bringing, inward knowledge, exact formula repetition, and epistemic asymmetry; I infer a retrieval-to-report arrow. A live alternative is that the concealed item in 31:16 is any fact, not specifically a deed.

changed_reading.before: God will later tell everyone what they did.
changed_reading.after: Final informing is an exposure process: even intention-scaled action hidden by enclosure or outward conformity is retrieved, traced to its inward source, and reported by the knower of inaccessible outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Handing over one's face to God, gripping a reliable bond, and locating the outcome with God provide the positive bodily structure behind the focus refusal. The ayah relocates submission rather than enthroning autonomous self-will.

activation_trace.role: Handing over and releasing the thing supplied makes submission an intentional transfer of the self.
Direction and orientation make the surrendered face the vector replacing parental command.
Holding and restraining supplies durable attachment to the alternative bond.
Settled trust in what can be relied on supplies the bond's warrant.
The last part and outcome direct the held orientation toward its terminal accountability.

structural_cues: 31:22 sequences surrender of face, grasp of a handle, and outcome to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an embodied orientation-grip-outcome sequence; I infer that it describes the positive structure of agency after 31:15's refusal. The alternative is that 31:22 generalizes faith without specifically resolving filial noncompliance.

changed_reading.before: The child leaves parental authority and chooses a better human guide.
changed_reading.after: The child releases a coercive command but not submission itself: the self is reoriented to God, attached to a warranted bond, and held toward God's outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overwhelming turbulence strips mixed allegiance into exclusive invocation, but rescue is followed by divergent degrees and possible betrayal. This distinguishes an episodic crisis-turn from the durable, traversable pattern required of the focus guide.

activation_trace.role: An all-encompassing cover supplies the crisis pressure that temporarily removes alternatives.
Interpenetrating turbulence makes the turn occur under unstable coercive conditions.
Exclusive separation from association supplies the crisis moment's purified orientation.
Obedience and yielding identify what is momentarily purified for God.
Escape by separation removes the pressure and creates the test of persistence.
A middle measure supplies one post-rescue degree rather than a uniform outcome.
Betrayal through failure to fulfill supplies the possibility that crisis purity does not persist.

structural_cues: 31:32 moves from engulfment, to exclusive invocation, to rescue, then divides post-rescue responses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure-induced exclusivity and divergent behavior after rescue; I infer that a guide's return must leave a durable path after pressure lifts. A live alternative is that the moderate survivor remains genuinely faithful, so the passage grades return rather than exposing it as false.

changed_reading.before: Follow anyone who turns to God.
changed_reading.after: Follow a return that persists as a traversable pattern: crisis-purity is real but does not by itself establish the durable orientation of a guide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later mirrored denial says neither generation can stand in for the other, then warns that the near life can deceive. The focus preserves reciprocal care while denying any transfer of conscience, liability, or final standing through kinship.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in the place of another is exactly the substitution denied in both filial directions.
Parenthood on both sides of birth supplies the mirrored relation whose final substitution fails.
The near or first world identifies the same provisional domain in which focus companionship operates.
Deception by what gleams without stability explains how worldly closeness can appear to authorize ultimate substitution.

structural_cues: 31:33 mirrors parent-for-child and child-for-parent before warning against worldly deception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal non-substitution, the near world, and deception; I infer that this later axiom explains the focus division between care and obedience. The alternative is that 31:33 concerns only final judgment and should not be projected back onto present authority.

changed_reading.before: Treat parents well now because everyone will be judged later.
changed_reading.after: Worldly kinship demands care but cannot delegate conscience: neither generation can occupy the other's place at return, so companionship never becomes transferred accountability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links material extraction, entrapment, and inward self-facilitation across distant branches. It remains anchored in the focus pressure-association-obedience-companionship chain; downstream prose should present it as a coercion analogy, not as the lexical meaning of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَاهَدَاكَ ... أَن تُشْرِكَ ... فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبْهُمَا

activation_trace.role: Repeated mixing or use that drains a thing models relational pressure extracting independent agency over time.
A hunter's trap supplies the capture structure into which the pressured association would draw the addressee.
The self making an act easy supplies internalization as the final stage of external pressure.
Deliberately keeping something in company preserves the bond without allowing the capture mechanism to govern.

changed_reading.before: Parents openly pressure the child to perform association.
changed_reading.after: Coercion may work gradually by relational mixing that drains resistance and makes capture feel self-enabled; the ayah interrupts internalization while retaining company.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because road-groove and sandal-strap senses of the association root are homonymous, branch-distant images. The reading remains anchored by the focus road and tracing construction and by ancestral following in 31:21; render it only as a spatial-material analogy for inherited attachment.

activation_trace.role: A sandal strap supplies the image of attachment between traveler and inherited route.
Grooves and main structures of a road supply a track already cut for the traveler.
The extended road anchors the material analogy in the focus's explicit wayfinding construction.
Tracing marks one after another supplies the act of inspecting rather than merely inheriting a groove.
Rival acts of following reveal that an already walked track can carry opposed destinations.
Ancestral nurture supplies the social force fastening the traveler to the inherited track.

changed_reading.before: Association is a proposition demanded by parents, opposed by a different path.
changed_reading.after: Association can be pictured as fastening oneself into inherited road-grooves; following the returning one requires examining traces and changing tracks, not merely changing companions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the packet's non-dominant mapping from the obedience root to a spatial root, so it is especially form-distant. It remains anchored by the focus refusal and contextual orientation imagery; downstream prose must label it a split-root spatial activation, never a translation of تُطِعْهُمَا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ... وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّ

activation_trace.role: An upright structural pole models a command becoming the support around which a person's action-space is organized.
Extension and rise through open air model coercive authority enlarging beyond its proper relational scope.
A visible beacon supplies an alternative orienting vertical to unsupported command.
Direction and orientation return the spatial analogy to the addressee's chosen alignment toward God.

changed_reading.before: Do not comply with this parental demand.
changed_reading.after: Do not let kin-pressure become the upright support that organizes the whole field of action; take orientation instead from the marked route toward God.

strongest_changes: Filial duty is partitioned: embodied debt, gratitude, and active good remain, but command-authority stops at unsupported association.
Following is neutral track-taking; the warranted route is marked by knowledge, guidance, revelation, repeated return, and persistence after pressure.
The return-report close is a retrieval audit of each party's purposive and hidden action, not an appended threat or transferable family account.
summary.what_was_special: The focus packs four different motions into one family scene: pressure, refused compliance, retained accompaniment, and chosen path-following. Context then repeats and reverses those motions across ancestry, hidden acts, crisis-return, surrender, and reciprocal non-substitution, allowing several live readings without collapsing them.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مَعْرُوفًا in 31:15 carries the full active public-norm force of 31:17 or only ordinary courteous treatment.
Whether 31:32 makes crisis-return insufficient for guidance or merely displays legitimate degrees of post-rescue fidelity.
The extraction, groove-and-strap, and split-root vertical models are anchored analogies but remain too branch-distant to use as lexical glosses.
